register.labelZh: TALK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: talk to 和 talk with 表示真正的交談;talk at 表示只顧自己說;talk down to 和 talk back 則可以描述不尊重對方的溝通方式。；talk into、talk out of 和 talk round 可以說明某人如何被說服去做某事、放棄某事或改變主意。；talk out、talk over 和 talk through 可以描述談開感受、商量選擇或仔細討論計劃的每一部分。；talk somebody down 可以表示安撫情緒激動的人;talk somebody through something 表示逐步提供協助;talk something up 則表示大力稱讚或宣傳。
register.summaryEn: Talk to and talk with describe a real conversation. Talk at describes one-sided speech, while talk down to and talk back describe disrespectful communication. Talk into, talk out of and talk round help you explain how someone was persuaded to do something, avoid something or change their mind. Talk out, talk over and talk through can describe discussing feelings, considering a choice or examining every part of a plan. Talk somebody down can describe calming an upset person. Talk somebody through something describes giving step-by-step help, while talk something up describes strong praise or promotion.
contextsZh: 解決問題和慎重作出決定
contextsEn: Talk about persuasion and changing decisions
Solve problems and make careful decisions
register.formalZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 TALK 片語動詞。
register.formalEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the TALK expression that gives the same meaning.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；talk around a subject 表示避開事情的重點;talk somebody round 則表示說服某人改變主意。；請按照以上例子排列人物或事物的位置。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Talk around a subject means to avoid its main point. Talk somebody round means to persuade that person to change their mind. Follow the word positions shown in these examples: talk him down talk her into joining talk it over talk them through the steps
